authorized_outcome_scope.allowed: click values from the first 1,811,697 raw-position-1 BTS rows only

features.inheritance: same training-only feature and preprocessing semantics as Study 2
features.user_features: all four raw user_feature_* fields, categorical one-hot levels learned from Study 3 BTS training only
features.item_context: women BTS item_context.csv, exact frozen item IDs 0..45; item_feature_0 numeric and item_feature_1..3 categorical
features.candidate_affinity: for logged training action a, use only user-item_affinity_a
features.numeric_scaling: training-only median imputation, mean centering, and population-standard-deviation scaling; zero variance uses scale=1

post_qualification_rule: A successful training qualification must be packaged and merged as a separate frozen result before any Study 3 BTS evaluation or Random-reference click value may be accessed.
no_post_outcome_tuning: Do not change solver, C, tolerance, max_iter, preprocessing, feature construction, target policy, estimators, bootstrap, clipping sensitivities, or ESS threshold based on this training result or any later Study 3 outcome.
outcome_visibility: This lock was created before any Study 3 training click was read by the qualification workflow.
